original_ai_output.title_zh: 夸拉州消防员从河中打捞出一名男子遗体
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚夸拉州消防局在伊洛林市库伦德地区皇家谷桥附近的河中打捞出一具身份不明的男子遗体，年龄估计为50岁。据该局公共关系官员声明，一名路人发现河中漂浮的遗体后通知电台，电台随后转告消防部门，消防员于周二下午3时44分抵达现场展开打捞。目前死者身份尚未确认，事件仅有一个来源报道。

location.raw_text: a river near Royal Valley Bridge in the Kulende area of Ilorin

key_facts.fact: 夸拉州消防局从伊洛林库伦德地区河中打捞出一具男子遗体
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Kwara State Fire Service has recovered the body of an unidentified man, estimated to be 50 years old, from a river near Royal Valley Bridge in the Kulende area of Ilorin.

key_facts.fact: 死者身份不明，年龄估计为50岁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the body of an unidentified man, estimated to be 50 years old

key_facts.fact: 打捞行动于周二下午3时44分开始
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: firefighters received the report and mobilised to the scene at 3:44 pm before commencing the recovery operation

key_facts.fact: 事件由路人发现河中漂浮遗体后经电台转报消防部门
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: a passerby who sighted the body floating in the river alerted a radio station, which subsequently notified the fire service

uncertainties: 死亡原因及是否涉及犯罪尚未证实
